run_gen_static_metadata: run gen_static_metadata.py with header source dictionary args to generate gRPC static metadata C++ files
run_mangle: run the mangle function to convert metadata config names into valid C identifier names
run_perfect_hash: run the perfect_hash function to generate a perfect hash table for gRPC metadata element lookup
run_esc_dict: run the esc_dict function to escape bytes for HPACK fuzzer dictionary output
run_fake_hash: run the fake_hash function to generate an MD5-based hash value for a metadata string
